description.value:
You can consult your guardian spirits, casting @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplAugury0000]{Augury} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplClairvoyan]{Clairvoyance} without a spell slot or Material components. Instead of a spherical sensor, this Clairvoyance invisibly summons one of your spirits to the chosen location. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells. After you cast either spell this way, you can't use this feature again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

Foundry Note

Both spells have one use per Short Rest: after casting one, spend the use of the other.
